cost_accounting.counting_rule: Each of 902 host attempts has its final parent CPU counted once: 900 scientific cells plus the undispatched 591 and 625 startups. No startup refund or duplicate scientific row. Parent samples are cumulative. Cell/segment/host clocks overlap and are not added. Preparation, earlier failed diagnostic runs, qualification and authoring costs remain separately bound histories.
cost_accounting.original_diagnostic_cpu_reason: Not measured with the required process-group boundary; no imputed cost.
cost_accounting.pause_scope: Separate operator/usage-interruption gap; not counted as active container wall. The 591 and 625 budgets are explicitly amended cumulative active allowances, not continuous original absolute 20s.

scope: Frozen modeled-policy/effect probes with actual isolated resource enforcement. Automated policy labels are not independent human legal or source-semantic judgments. The compact records do not retain full per-cell proof/capability payloads; pinned executed mechanisms, effect counters and durable shared-state identity support the stated runtime observations. No blanket compiler soundness, theorem-proof validity, model efficacy or independent human fidelity is inferred.
